name: Release v0.102.3001.0
body:
# Release v0.102.3001.0

This hotfix release addresses crashes in File Locksmith and Quick Accent. See the [v0.102.2933.0 release notes](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/releases/tag/v0.102.2933.0) for the full list of changes in PowerToys v0.102.

## Installer Hashes

| Description | Filename | SHA256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Per user - x64 | [PowerToysUserSetup-0.102.3001.0-x64.exe][ptUserX64] | `4459B9F1AD5D70A342E109FFB66DBBB08EA07B2D2EC5634B314F878700F9FF0B` |
| Per user - ARM64 | [PowerToysUserSetup-0.102.3001.0-arm64.exe][ptUserArm64] | `074208C93541BE77BB6E875D436A8A765E21649F2613196CEE62D9CA936611F2` |
| Machine wide - x64 | [PowerToysSetup-0.102.3001.0-x64.exe][ptMachineX64] | `3FB386E628296D6F960F8EFC92B47FAFA9E29C915C5EFD774255A95190DCC87D` |
| Machine wide - ARM64 | [PowerToysSetup-0.102.3001.0-arm64.exe][ptMachineArm64] | `1D6A23E643B4E34EA1C3292AD4F8615BC1082AC938B0998D56899264DDA5E2AD` |

## Highlights

This patch contains two fixes since the previous stable release.

### File Locksmith

- Fixed crashes when File Locksmith encounters a stalled file-handle scan, including crashes after the scan completes, in [#51507](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/51507).

### Quick Accent

- Fixed Quick Accent crashes when using arrow-key activation after changing languages or switching from a shorter character list, in [#51583](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/51583).
